header: What changed at the sites that have been live a year
lead: Figures come from the sites themselves rather than from us: each one is the median across 34 organisations comparing their first month with their twelfth.
note: Sites with fewer than fifteen employees are excluded, because a single long-term absence moves their figures more than anything we do.

metrics.title: Less time spent planning
metrics.text: Copying last week forward, and rules checked while the shift is moved rather than afterwards.

metrics.title: Fewer unplanned overtime hours
metrics.text: Wage cost shown against the branch budget before the week is published.

metrics.title: Faster month-end close
metrics.text: Approved hours exported straight to payroll instead of being retyped.
